blocks.text: Receptors aaza, tissues, cells ya cells ke hisse hain jo bairooni ya andaruni mahol ki tabdeeliyan (stimuli) pakar kar apne sensory neurons mein nerve impulses paida karte hain. Agle topics zaiqe, boo, lams aur dard ke receptors bayan karte hain.

blocks.title: Free nerve endings
blocks.text: Sab se saada receptors free nerve endings hain jo darja-e-hararat ki tabdeeli ya extracellular fluid ke kimiyai maddon jaise muharrik par jawab dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Tamam receptors muharrik ke saath kya karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Use pakar kar apne sensory neurons mein nerve impulses mein badalte hain (transducers ka kaam).

items: Receptors muharrik pakar kar sensory neurons mein impulses banate hain; free nerve endings sab se saada hain.
